entities.title: utv-core (Java)
entities.summary: The Java library of UTV: typed temporal values and outcomes, built on the 0.2 JSON layer, with the shared fixtures and two example suites as its tests.
entities.purpose: Holds one Maven project, net.icelander.utv:utv-core 0.3.0 for Java 21 or later: the library in src/main/java/net/icelander/utv, and its JUnit tests in src/test/java/net/icelander/utv, which read the shared conformance material from the repository root in place.
boundaries: The contracts it implements (docs/library-api.md, docs/everyday-api.md, docs/text-form.md, spec/) and the shared fixtures (conformance/) belong to the repository; this folder only reads them.
It ships no zone rules or other registries: a caller loads rule data and passes it in.
The library's versions are recorded in CHANGELOG.md, as VERSIONING.md requires.
